I play MTG and played Pokemon the day it came out, I agree they are skill based.

However with casinos popping up everywhere new challenges are going to emerge as to who has the right to host card games, how we apply the predominant factor test to every new game, and when an entry fee is gambling.

I've played MTG since 94' and have a massive collection

Laws predating TCGs have no carve outs

Courts have consistently held that tournament entry is consideration and TCGs are card games with cash prizes or equivalents which makes them falls explicitly into the gambling restrictions

However this has been mostly overlooked by law enforcement.
